description: REFEPS (Buscador Nacional de Profesionales de la Salud, argentina.gob.ar) — looks up a health professional's national license by number, no credentials needed (a public Drupal form). TURNOS_REFEPS_URL overrides the search URL for tests/mirrors. The provincial colmed9 (Colegio de Medicos PBA Distrito IX) lookup, which HAS photos REFEPS lacks, is intentionally NOT a connector here — it's the doctor-lookup operator skill's own tooling, queried by a human/agent during cartilla curation, never called at runtime by the app.
